title: Share this entry with Nora
body:
Share the text of this journal entry with Nora for this Athletic Mind program. PulseCheck and AuntEdna systems will process this entry, its type, timestamps, and sharing status to support you and look for signs you may need help. The entry can be included in daily or requested Athletic Mind snapshots while this choice and your program permission remain active. This is a separate choice from saving a private entry or running its safety check.

This choice does not give a coach, trainer, parent, or team clinician access to your private entry. Sharing with a person requires permission for that person and information. An emergency concern may follow the separate immediate AuntEdna clinical handoff. Authorized service personnel may access information for their assigned operational, security, or incident duties under applicable agreements.

You can stop sharing this entry. Editing it stops sharing the old revision until you share the updated entry again. Deleting it stops future access. Records already received must be handled by the recipient under the program retention and deletion agreement; withdrawal cannot undo processing that already happened. Choosing a setting for new entries affects only entries you save afterward. Earlier private entries stay private.
